notes.title: Demo Update Live!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Thanks to your feedback we've made a number of significant updates to the demo, including adding Spanish VO, keybind customization, and more! [/p][list][*][p]Spanish voices and text localization added[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon damage rebalanced[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard key binding support implemented[/p][/*][*][p]New special death animations[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution issues above Full HD fixed[/p][/*][*][p]DLSS temporarily disabled due to performance problems[/p][/*][*][p]New tutorials added[/p][/*][*][p]Various bugs fixed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: POOR DEMO PERFORMANCE
notes.content: [p]We’ve detected issues with DLSS that may cause frame drops. [/p][p][/p][p]While we work on a fix, we recommend:[/p][p][/p][p]- Using XeSS or TSR as alternative[/p][p]- Set reflections to Medium for the best experience. They set to Low by default sometimes.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your understanding![/p]

notes.title: Demo OUT NOW
notes.content: [h1]Crisol demo now available[/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="wk--ShC5Pds;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We are so excited to finally share the demo for Crisol: Theater of Idols with you! This demo is a small portion of an early chapter in the game, giving you a glimpse at the combat, blood reload mechanic, an alternate weapon that you can find, and a few other secrets that we can't wait to discuss. The horrors of Tormentosa await... [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3989380/Crisol_Theater_of_Idols_Demo" style="button"]PLAY NOW[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
